sourceBoundary.public_decision: If an idea is only known through leaked or non-public material, do not use it. Re-derive a safe pattern from official docs or local platform needs instead.

patterns.label: Permissioned Tool Execution
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: Settings and permissions have scopes and precedence, while CLAUDE.md-style instructions are contextual guidance rather than hard enforcement.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Separate behavioral guidance from enforced execution policy.
patterns.platformMapping: Keep CLI adapters optional, use allowlisted Tauri commands, persist human decisions, and route unsafe source-affecting choices through the decision inbox.
implementationTargets: Show permission and source-boundary status in Workspace Monitor
Add per-adapter permission summaries before source-affecting task pipes
riskControls: no global CLI install without audit
explicit human checkpoint for destructive operations

patterns.label: Plan Before Edit
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: Plan mode reads files and proposes a plan before disk edits for changes that need review.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Use reversible planning gates before durable source or policy edits.
patterns.platformMapping: Map plan mode to work modes, spec-driven tasks, task pipe merge gates, and decision inbox checkpoints.
implementationTargets: Add a first-class Plan Gate indicator to Desktop task pipes
Show blocked decisions next to the source editor before Save All
riskControls: mode selection record for non-quick work

patterns.label: Durable Instruction Memory
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: CLAUDE.md and auto memory are loaded into sessions, but enforcement belongs in settings or hooks.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Keep shared durable instructions thin, traceable, and separate from hard policy.
patterns.platformMapping: Use AGENTS.md as a runtime adapter entrypoint and keep durable policy in shared docs/configs with memory bootstrap anchors.
implementationTargets: Show memory bootstrap hot anchors in Workspace Monitor
Flag adapter instructions that duplicate durable policy
riskControls: do not fork durable policy across adapters
specific concise instructions over vague preferences

patterns.label: Subagent Context Isolation
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: Subagents preserve main context by handling side tasks in separate contexts with scoped tool access.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Treat exploration, research, validation, implementation, and merge gates as separate lanes with explicit summaries.
patterns.platformMapping: Expose agent collaboration lanes, task pipe presets, blockers, and merge gates rather than dumping every log into the main task view.
implementationTargets: Add per-lane context budget and summary contracts
Surface lane handoff quality in Unified Ops
riskControls: parallel lanes need non-overlapping touch paths

patterns.label: MCP Connector Boundary
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: MCP connects external tools and data sources, but trust and prompt-injection risks must be reviewed before connecting servers.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Connectors are optional capability cards with trust, scope, and lifecycle checks.
patterns.platformMapping: Keep MCP-style connectors behind capability setup, permission review, and source-boundary warnings rather than making them required platform runtime dependencies.
implementationTargets: Add connector cards next to CLI adapter cards
Record connector trust decisions in the decision inbox

patterns.label: Hook Event Automation
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: Hooks can run commands around tool and session events, and command hooks run with the user's permissions.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Automation hooks need explicit event schemas, allowlists, rollback, and resource guards.
patterns.platformMapping: Use hook-like workflows only after modeling event input/output, cleanup, and user permission impact.
implementationTargets: Create a platform hook registry with disabled-by-default executable hooks
Show hook risk state in Desktop Capability Center

patterns.label: Skill On-Demand Packaging
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: Skills package repeatable workflows and load detailed instructions only when relevant.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Promote repeated work into the smallest durable capability before adding product code.
patterns.platformMapping: Use templates, tools, skills, prompts, workflows, and agents as staged capability assets; surface promotion candidates in evidence/promotion views.
implementationTargets: Show skill candidates from work history bottlenecks
Link skill validation results into Workspace Monitor
riskControls: forward-test before relying on a skill

patterns.label: Parallel Worktree Sessions
patterns.claudeCodeSignal: Parallel sessions can run in separate worktrees to reduce edit collisions.
patterns.transferPrinciple: Parallel execution requires branch/worktree isolation or explicit touch-path locks.
patterns.platformMapping: Task pipes should record lane touch paths, dependencies, and merge strategy before launching overlapping implementation work.
implementationTargets: Add worktree-aware task pipe launch options
Show touch-path conflict warnings before multi-lane source edits
riskControls: no overlapping write paths without lock or handoff

stages.label: Philosophy Intake
stages.input: _philosophy source text and the user request
stages.output: principle ids, changed values, and affected product surfaces
checks: private or sensitive material is excluded

stages.label: Principle Clustering
stages.input: principle ids and current traceability registry
stages.output: feature flow lane and affected capability class
checks: every required principle has at least one flow

stages.label: Human Process Model
stages.input: principle cluster and observed work signals
stages.output: competent human work sequence and judgment checkpoints
checks: goal, context, sources, options, decision, verification, handoff, and review are covered

stages.label: Feature Candidate Generation
stages.input: human process model and existing platform assets
stages.output: multiple candidate feature ideas with lighter alternatives
checks: do-nothing or defer option included when evidence is weak

stages.label: Idea Evaluation
stages.output: scored selected, rejected, queued, or deferred candidate
checks: repetition reduction, time savings, evidence, risk, maintenance, and smallest-asset fit are scored

stages.label: Asset Selection
stages.output: prompt, workflow, template, tool, skill, agent, or project feature target

stages.label: Implementation Trace
stages.output: files changed, ownership, and rollback plan
checks: rollback or disablement path is concrete

stages.label: Validation And Rework
stages.output: validation result, evaluator result, and residual risks
checks: config, test, UI, and philosophy trace checks run where relevant

stages.label: Data Accumulation
stages.output: history, feature candidate, evidence, timing, and evaluation records
checks: source, assumptions, decisions, validation, and residual risks are recorded
records are usable by the next agent

flows.label: Evidence And Judgment Loop
flows.featureQuestion: What product capability prevents guesses, weak sources, missing plans, unsupported claims, or unreviewed output from becoming final work?
candidateRules: Create evidence capture, research synthesis, grounding, evaluator, or rework-loop assets before new presentation features.
Prefer deterministic checks when the principle can be validated mechanically.

flows.label: Capability Factory Loop
flows.featureQuestion: What repeated human work can be structured into the smallest reusable asset while preserving provenance and validation?
candidateRules: Model the direct human process before generating feature ideas.
Select prompt, workflow, template, tool, skill, agent, then project feature in that order.
Record structured data quality before using a candidate as evidence.

flows.label: Boundary And Authority Loop
flows.featureQuestion: What product capability keeps autonomy bounded, records usable, privacy protected, and owner decisions visible?
candidateRules: Add boundary, view-mode, decision inbox, guardrail, rollback, cost, or privacy capabilities before broad automation.
Do not rely on client-side hiding or prompt-only prohibitions for sensitive or irreversible work.

qualityGates.rule: A candidate without source_principle_ids cannot be promoted.
qualityGates.failureAction: Return to philosophy_intake and select the source principle ids.

qualityGates.rule: A candidate must describe the competent human process step it reduces or improves.
qualityGates.failureAction: Return to human_process_model and write the direct work sequence.

qualityGates.rule: A candidate must justify why a lighter asset type is insufficient before becoming an agent or project feature.
qualityGates.failureAction: Re-score against smallest_asset_fit and queue heavier work if needed.

qualityGates.rule: A candidate cannot become active without validation targets and rollback or disablement plan.
qualityGates.failureAction: Keep the candidate planned or blocked until validation and rollback are concrete.

qualityGates.rule: Candidate records must preserve source, assumptions, decision, validation, uncertainty, and residual risk.
qualityGates.failureAction: Create or update history, trace, evaluation, or feature-candidate records before close-out.

candidates.label: Philosophy Feature Factory
candidates.humanProcessStep: A human rereads the user's principles, clusters them into product questions, checks existing assets, drafts several features, selects the smallest asset, then records validation and rollback.
candidates.featureHypothesis: A registry, checker, workflow, prompt, agent spec, and monitor panel will make philosophy-derived feature generation explicit and repeatable.

validationTargets.validates: Philosophy-derived feature extraction registry remains complete and mechanically checkable.
Agent platform governance tests remain green.

validationTargets.command: corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor run check && corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor test
validationTargets.validates: Monitor snapshot and UI type contracts still expose the philosophy feature factory.

candidates.rollbackPlan: Remove the registry, checker command, monitor panel, prompt, workflow, and agent spec; then remove the philosophy traceability and memory bootstrap references.

candidates.label: Philosophy Candidate Inbox
candidates.humanProcessStep: A human keeps feature ideas visible, waits for owner arbitration when values conflict, and separates safe drafts from blocked decisions.
candidates.featureHypothesis: A persistent candidate inbox can show philosophy-derived feature proposals with status, owner decision needs, and resume actions.

validationTargets.validates: Candidate decisions and blocked work are not silently skipped.

candidates.rollbackPlan: Archive the candidate inbox and keep only this registry as the source of planned philosophy-derived features.

candidates.label: Principle To Spec Template
candidates.humanProcessStep: A human turns a value into acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, implementation plan, traceability, validation, and rework criteria.
candidates.featureHypothesis: A template can reduce gaps when a philosophy point should become requirements and specs.

validationTargets.validates: Template path and project boundaries remain valid.

candidates.rollbackPlan: Remove the template folder and keep the workflow-only route.

candidates.label: Philosophy Gate In Work Evaluator
candidates.humanProcessStep: A reviewer checks whether the completed work actually reflects the source principles it claims to implement.
candidates.featureHypothesis: The work evaluator can require philosophy_feature_targets when a task changes platform direction or durable operating behavior.

validationTargets.validates: Evaluation fails when required philosophy feature targets are missing.

candidates.rollbackPlan: Remove the evaluator field requirement and keep philosophy feature checks as a separate close-out command.

candidates.label: Data Quality Signal Dashboard
candidates.humanProcessStep: A human scans accumulated records for provenance, freshness, validation, contradiction, and usefulness before reusing them.
candidates.featureHypothesis: The monitor can show data-quality signals so stored knowledge is treated as reusable only when provenance and validation are visible.

validationTargets.command: corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor run check && corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor test
validationTargets.validates: Dashboard signals remain type-safe and snapshot-backed.

candidates.rollbackPlan: Hide the dashboard section and keep data-quality checks as CLI/report-only workflow.

외부 자료는 기능 정리 방식의 참고로만 사용했다. Atlassian 자료는 user feedback을 backlog/roadmap에 연결하고, roadmap을 Now/Next/Later로 볼 수 있다는 점을 참고했다.
public release readiness 같은 사실 주장은 repository의 service readiness 기록과 validation output을 기준으로 했다.

productPosition.productClaim: A desktop platform for orchestrating agents, giving them a real work and development environment, making agents easier to create, and improving them through accumulated task, decision, evidence, validation, and evaluation data.

desktopHomeSurface.homeCopyRule: The first screen should explain what the user can make agents do, create, and improve; observability appears as a support signal, not the headline.
desktopHomeSurface.configurationRule: Settings, setup, optional CLI configuration, and editor preferences belong to dedicated settings or capability surfaces rather than the top of the home view.

featureLayers.label: Agent Orchestration
featureLayers.purpose: Coordinate multiple agent or CLI lanes as a supervised task graph with bounded IO, decision routing, merge gates, and cleanup.
featureLayers.userOutcome: The user starts one task and the platform coordinates specialized lanes, pauses only dependent decisions, and keeps independent work moving.
validationGates: readiness test includes product feature architecture
customer snapshot preserves feature claims without internal source

featureLayers.label: Agent Work Environment
featureLayers.purpose: Host app-selected workspaces, runtime data stores, task-run records, decisions, support diagnostics, and agent work planes.
featureLayers.userOutcome: The user no longer has to manually clone and work from a terminal-first folder; the app owns workspace selection and accumulated data access.
validationGates: workspace boundary commands reject unsafe paths

featureLayers.label: Agent Development Environment
featureLayers.purpose: Provide the developer workbench for source review, multi-file edits, diffs, templates, requirements, specs, validation, and runtime contracts.
featureLayers.userOutcome: The user can shape agent platform behavior inside a desktop workbench instead of bouncing between loose files and terminal-only flows.
validationGates: Monaco code workbench is not only an embed
file writes stay within workspace root
requirements and specs trace product feature changes

featureLayers.label: Agent Factory
featureLayers.purpose: Turn repeated work into prompts, workflows, templates, tools, skills, agents, and finally platform features with traceable decisions.
featureLayers.userOutcome: The user can create agents and reusable capabilities without repeatedly telling the assistant the same process.
validationGates: candidate has source evidence and rollback plan
promotion selects the smallest useful asset first

featureLayers.label: Learning & Evaluation Loop
featureLayers.purpose: Accumulate work history, timing, evaluations, web searches, intent maps, evidence, and improvement records so platform behavior gets better over time.
featureLayers.userOutcome: The user can see why the platform improved, what evidence drove changes, and which gaps remain.
validationGates: new product work creates request trace and work summary

featureLayers.label: Observability & Monitoring
featureLayers.purpose: Expose structure, history, documents, source inventory, diagnostics, and status so the primary agent platform features can be understood and trusted.
featureLayers.userOutcome: The user can inspect accumulated data and platform state without mistaking that inspection layer for the whole product.

promotionLoop.improvementRule: When repeated human work, agent failures, omitted steps, validation failures, or useful patterns recur, create the smallest durable asset first and promote only when evidence justifies a larger feature.

qualitySignals: The first screen names primary agent platform features before observability.
Snapshot data includes product feature architecture for developer and customer builds.
Customer snapshot preserves sellable feature structure but removes internal source paths and validation internals.
Readiness tests fail if monitoring is positioned as the primary product.
New feature work updates requirements, specs, validation, history, and request traces.

validationGates.validates: Product feature registry keeps agent capability platform as the primary product and monitoring as supporting observability.
Workspace snapshot collector exposes product feature architecture and customer snapshot sanitization.
Customer bundle keeps product feature structure while stripping internal documents, source files, and implementation-only paths.

validationGates.command: cd agent-platform && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m agent_platform.cli check-config-contract ../platform-desktop-app/configs/product-feature-registry.json

checklist: Review src/generated/workspace-snapshot.json before making the repository public.
Remove or redact private notes, secrets, raw prompts, or local-only paths that should not be published.
Regenerate the snapshot after any redaction and run pnpm run build again.
